text:
hana: quick report from support  customers hit two problems in the pricing + metering docs after today's deploy: a few anchors 404 and our SDK header examples are inconsistent across languages. can someone own a small patch?
omar: can you paste the failing links?
hana: sure  /pricing#banked-credits and /pricing#metering-metrics both return 404. also /docs/metering/headers.md mixes Authorization and x-api-key. one of our Go snippets even uses GenerateText().
lucy: thanks. we renamed several dashboard slugs to consumption-* last sprint which likely caused the 404s. preferred fix: add redirects.yml entries for the old anchors -> new anchors so external links don't break.
rafael: i'll update the Go snippet and check other languages. plan: replace legacy GenerateText with client.Generate(...) and standardize header guidance to use x-api-key passed via env var. will also add a one-line migration note in /docs/migration/headers.md explaining the header change and why (uniformity + kms routing).
hana: support also asked for a short worked example showing how "banked credits" decay over time when unused. they'd like a tiny numeric example and a compact formula we can paste into the doc.
omar: keep the banked-credit worked example short. suggestion: "Banked credits remaining = starting_credits - used_credits + credits_earned" with a numeric example: start 10k + earn 2k - use 3k = 9k. add a tiny python helper.
lucy: adding a small Python helper and a Go helper snippet will be helpful for customers. don't log raw keys: use env var placeholder.
rafael: draft Python helper (will include in PR): `def banked_remaining(start, earned, used):
    return start + earned - used
# example: banked_remaining(10000, 2000, 3000) -> 9000`
rafael: draft Go snippet (metering header + generate): `client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{Model: "rwd/light-2", Input: "hello"}, redwood.RequestOptions{Headers: map[string]string{"x-api-key": os.Getenv("RW_KEY")}})`
hana: nice. also add a redirects.yml entry mapping /pricing#banked-credits -> /pricing#banked-allowance and /pricing#metering-metrics -> /pricing#consumption-metrics. include a small unit test that asserts the redirect keys exist. last week's redirect test flapped, so please run locally first.
lucy: I'll open the PR and include a checklist in the description: 1) add redirects.yml entries, 2) update dashboard anchor names in docs text, 3) standardize SDK snippets (py/go/ts) to show x-api-key via env var and use client.Generate, 4) add banked credits worked example + helpers, 5) add migration note and changelog entry, 6) backport to docs-1.2 branch for enterprise customers.
docs-bot: PR #5055 opened by lucy  "docs: redirects + SDK header standardization + banked credits example". Reviewers requested: @omar, @hana. CI: queued.
omar: i'll review after CI. tiny SDK nit: for TS show `await client.generate({ model: 'rwd/light-2', input: '...' }, { headers: { 'x-api-key': process.env.RW_KEY } })` rather than older signatures.
hana: thanks. ping when staging preview is ready and i'll QA. :thumbsup:
lucy: will run redirect tests locally and aim to merge today if CI is green. will post updates here.
